name: Showboat
description: Word is you spin around like a circus act before you shoot. Fine. Drop someone with a 360 and I'll stop laughing. Any target, any rifle that can do it.

name: Around the World
description: A Mosin is more than a museum piece, if the hands are right. Three 360 kills with a bolt-action and the scope is yours.

name: Spin Doctor
description: PMCs pay for their reputations and I sell the tapes. Two of them, spun and dropped. Style is the product.
